annotation.title_clean: An Act Promoting the Development and Regulation of Artificial Intelligence in the Philippines (Artificial Intelligence Development and Regulation Act of the Philippines)
annotation.title_en: An Act Promoting the Development and Regulation of Artificial Intelligence in the Philippines (Artificial Intelligence Development and Regulation Act of the Philippines)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: House of Representatives of the Philippines (Rep. Steve Chiongbian Solon)
annotation.venue: House of Representatives of the Philippines, 20th Congress
annotation.summary_en: Philippine House bill creating a general framework to promote and regulate AI. It establishes an Artificial Intelligence Development Authority under the Office of the President to craft a National AI Strategy and oversee ethics compliance. Robotics appears only in the AI system definition. Penalties follow existing laws.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Artificial Intelligence Development Authority (AIDA) with a Board of Trustees drawn from agencies, industry and academe
AIDA to formulate a National AI Strategy and oversee compliance with AI ethics principles
Objectives: transparent, accountable, fair AI; R&D, infrastructure and workforce development
Violations penalized under existing laws; AIDA issues implementing rules
Provides appropriations and international cooperation on AI norms and standards
